text:
Served items, estimated:
- Latte, about 350 ml: 180 kcal, 9 g protein, 14 g carbs, 9 g fat.
- Greek yogurt cup, about 150 g, plain: 140 kcal, 14 g protein, 6 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Two slices of whole wheat toast: 160 kcal, 7 g protein, 28 g carbs, 2 g fat.
- Two fried eggs: 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat.
- Dry oats (about 40 g) with raisins (about 15 g) and almonds (about 10 g): 270 kcal, 8 g protein, 40 g carbs, 8 g fat.
- Savory muffin, about 120 g: 350 kcal, 9 g protein, 35 g carbs, 19 g fat.

That gives about 1280 kcal served.

Leftovers are small: some yolk, a bit of egg white, some muffin crumbs, yogurt residue and a little of the drink. I estimate about 50 kcal left over, so about 1230 kcal eaten.
